name: Sa11y
description: Applies the Sa11y in-page accessibility checker for editors.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Sa11y 
 Integrates the Sa11y accessibility checker into Drupal.

 NOTE: this is a new module, not an upgrade to the module that was at this namespace. There is no relationship between this module and the previous version. 

 Back to top 

 Using 
 Enable the module like any other Drupal module. Set what roles can use the Sa11y widget via the use_sa11y permission.

 The module is set to only work on pages that are not using the admin theme.

 Now when you visit any page on your site using your frontend theme, you should see the Sa11y widget in the bottom right corner.
